question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 280.0-290.0 MHz en États-Unis ?
answer: La bande 280.0-290.0 MHz en États-Unis est allouée au service : MILITARY FIXED / MOBILE. Application principale : NATO UHF MILSATCOM downlink (FLTSATCOM, UFO legacy); military LOS tactical communications; MUOS (Mobile User Objective System) UHF MILSATCOM downlinks. Note : Federal Government exclusive band. No civilian access. Part of NATO UHF SATCOM allocation (225-400 MHz). FLTSATCOM fleet broadcast channels operate near 280-290 MHz. [FACTCHECK: AEHF operates at EHF (44 GHz UL / 20 GHz DL), not UHF. MUOS is the correct current UHF MILSATCOM system.]

question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 328.6-335.4 MHz en États-Unis ?
answer: La bande 328.6-335.4 MHz en États-Unis est allouée au service : AERONAUTICAL RADIONAVIGATION (ILS Glide Path). Application principale : Instrument Landing System (ILS) Glide Path/Glide Slope transmitters for precision runway approach. 40 ILS channels between 329.15-335.00 MHz paired with localizer frequencies 108.10-111.95 MHz.. Note : ILS Glide Path is an ICAO-mandated worldwide allocation. 40 channels from 329.15 MHz to 335.00 MHz with 150 kHz spacing. Each GS frequency is paired with a Localizer frequency. Category III ILS provides autoland capability. This is an exclusively aeronautical band — no other users permitted.

question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 350.0-370.0 MHz en Chine ?
answer: La bande 350.0-370.0 MHz en Chine est allouée au service : MOBILE (Government) / LAND MOBILE. Application principale : PDT (Police Digital Trunking) — Chinese public safety digital radio standard, used by Chinese police (Gong An), fire, and emergency services. This is China's equivalent of TETRA but uses a different standard.. Note : CRITICAL: China does NOT use TETRA in the 380-395 MHz band like Europe. Instead, China uses PDT (Police Digital Trunking) in 350-370 MHz. PDT was developed by Hytera and standardized by the Chinese Ministry of Public Security. PDT is technically similar to DMR but with Chinese-specific features including built-in encryption, GPS, and dispatching. Over 1 million PDT terminals deployed in China as of 2020.

question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 402.0-405.0 MHz en mondial ?
answer: La bande 402.0-405.0 MHz en mondial est allouée au service : Medical Implant Communications Service (MICS) / MedRadio. Application principale : Ultra-low-power wireless communication between implanted medical devices and external programmer/monitor units. Range 2-5 meters. Used for pacemaker interrogation, implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) data retrieval, neurostimulator programming.. Note : 10 channels of 300 kHz each within the 402-405 MHz core band. Frequency error shall not exceed +/-100 ppm. Wing bands at 401-402 MHz and 405-406 MHz added by FCC in 2009 (MedRadio expansion). MICS is ITU worldwide allocation ensuring interoperability for patients traveling internationally. Biotronik and Medtronic developed home monitoring systems using MICS band.

question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 406.0-406.1 MHz en mondial ?
answer: La bande 406.0-406.1 MHz en mondial est allouée au service : Cospas-Sarsat Distress Beacons (Mobile-Satellite Service). Application principale : Emergency distress alerting via satellite. EPIRB (maritime), PLB (personal/land), ELT (aviation). Internationally protected frequency - transmissions restricted exclusively to distress signaling.. Note : ABSOLUTELY PROTECTED BAND worldwide. No other transmissions permitted. Channel plan per C/S T.012 covers 406.025-406.076 MHz with channels at 406.025, 406.028, 406.031, 406.037, 406.040 MHz and more. Beacons transmit 0.5s burst every 50s. LEOSAR (Cospas) and GEOSAR (GOES/Meteosat/INSAT) satellite detection. MEOSAR (Galileo/GLONASS/GPS SAR) provides near-instantaneous global coverage with return link service. All 406 MHz beacons must be registered with national authority. [FACTCHECK ADDITION: ITU RR 5.266 also applies — prohibits harmful interference to Cospas-Sarsat band.]

question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 433.42 MHz en France ?
answer: La bande 433.42 MHz en France est allouée au service : SRD - Somfy RTS Protocol. Application principale : Somfy RTS (Radio Technology Somfy) motorized blinds, shutters, awnings, and screen control. Dominant home automation protocol in France for window coverings.. Note : Somfy uses EXACTLY 433.42 MHz (NOT 433.92 MHz) for the RTS protocol. Data is Manchester encoded: rising edge = 1, falling edge = 0. 56-bit payload scrambled by XORing each byte with previous scrambled byte. Rolling code is 16 bits wide but receiver acceptance window of ~100 codes means effective entropy is 9-10 bits. Frame structure: wake-up pulses, hardware sync (2 high pulses), software sync (1 long high pulse of ~4550 us), then Manchester-encoded data. Somfy has shipped over 200 million RTS devices worldwide.

answer: La bande 865-868 MHz en France est allouée au service : SRD Sub-band L — RFID / LoRaWAN additional / SRDs. question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 1030 MHz en France ?
answer: La bande 1030 MHz en France est allouée au service : AERONAUTICAL RADIONAVIGATION (SSR Interrogation). Application principale : Secondary Surveillance Radar (SSR) interrogation frequency. Ground radar and airborne TCAS send interrogations on 1030 MHz. Aircraft transponder replies on 1090 MHz. Mode A (identity), Mode C (altitude), Mode S (selective address). Also used by military IFF (Identification Friend or Foe).. Note : 1030 MHz is THE worldwide SSR interrogation frequency. All countries use it identically. This is a single-frequency, not a band. The paired reply frequency is 1090 MHz.

Référence réglementaire : EU Commission Implementing Regulation 2020/587 (amending 1207/2011) / ICAO Annex 10 Vol IV / EUROCAE ED-102A (ADS-B) / ED-73E (Mode S) / RTCA DO-260B. Limite de puissance : Transponder: 125-500W peak (21-27 dBm average); ADS-B 1090ES: minimum 75W peak (Class A1/A2 per EUROCAE ED-102A); TCAS reply: up to 250W peak. Modulation : PPM (Pulse Position Modulation), 1 Mbps data rate. ADS-B Extended Squitter format: DF17 (Downlink Format 17), 112-bit message (56-bit ME field contains position, velocity, identity). Mode S short reply: 56 bits. Mode S long reply: 112 bits.. Région ITU : Worldwide (ICAO / ITU).

question: Quels appareils et utilisateurs opèrent sur 1090 MHz en France ?
answer: Appareils typiques : Aircraft transponders: Garmin GTX 345 (GA), Garmin GTX 335 (GA), Collins TDR-94D (transport), Honeywell KT 73 (GA), uAvionix tailBeaconX (light aircraft), Trig TT22; Ground ADS-B receivers: Thales, Leonardo; Hobbyist receivers: FlightAware Pro Stick Plus, RTL-SDR Blog V3 dongle + dump1090-mutability, AirNav RadarBox, Flightradar24 receiver kit. Utilisateurs : SSR transponder reply frequency (Mode A/C/S) and ADS-B Extended Squitter (1090ES). EU mandate: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2020/587 (amending 1207/2011) requires ADS-B Out capability for IFR aircraft in European airspace since June 7, 2020. DSNA (Direction des services de la navigation aerienne) operates French ADS-B ground stations..

question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 1090 MHz en États-Unis ?
answer: La bande 1090 MHz en États-Unis est allouée au service : AERONAUTICAL RADIONAVIGATION (SSR Transponder Reply + ADS-B 1090ES). Application principale : SSR transponder reply and ADS-B 1090ES. US ADS-B mandate: FAR 91.225/91.227 requires ADS-B Out since January 1, 2020 for aircraft operating in Class A/B/C airspace, above Class C, within 30 nm of Class B, and above 10,000 ft MSL. FAA accepts both 1090ES and 978 UAT (978 MHz, US-only below 18,000 ft).. Note : US ADS-B mandate effective January 1, 2020. US is unique in allowing 978 UAT as an alternative to 1090ES below FL180. Above FL180, only 1090ES is accepted.

question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 1090 MHz en France ?
answer: La bande 1090 MHz en France est allouée au service : ADS-B Civilian Tracking (Receive-only). Application principale : Civilian ADS-B tracking and flight monitoring. Hobbyist and commercial receive-only stations feeding data to flight tracking platforms. Legal to receive in all countries (passive reception).. Note : ADS-B tracking is legal worldwide as receive-only. Major platforms: Flightradar24 (~35,000 feeders), FlightAware (~30,000 PiAware stations), ADS-B Exchange (community-driven, unfiltered), OpenSky Network (academic/research). Most use RTL-SDR dongles (~$25) with dump1090 or readsb decoder software on Raspberry Pi.

question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 978 MHz en États-Unis ?
answer: La bande 978 MHz en États-Unis est allouée au service : AERONAUTICAL SURVEILLANCE (UAT - Universal Access Transceiver). Application principale : UAT (Universal Access Transceiver) at 978 MHz. US-only ADS-B alternative to 1090ES, authorized for use below FL180 (18,000 ft). Provides ADS-B Out and FIS-B (weather/TFR) and TIS-B (traffic) services. NOT used outside the US.. Note : 978 MHz UAT is UNIQUE TO THE US. No other country uses UAT. It provides free weather (FIS-B: NEXRAD, METARs, TAFs, TFRs) and traffic information (TIS-B) to GA pilots. Above FL180, only 1090ES is accepted. Approximately 50% of US GA fleet uses UAT rather than 1090ES.

question: Quelle est la fonction de la bande 960-1030 MHz en France ?
answer: La bande 960-1030 MHz en France est allouée au service : AERONAUTICAL RADIONAVIGATION (DME Interrogator band). Application principale : DME interrogator frequencies. Aircraft DME interrogators transmit in 1025-1150 MHz range (X channel) but many DME ground transponder reply frequencies fall in 962-1024 MHz. This sub-band contains DME transponder replies and some DME interrogator channels.. Note : DME channel scheme: 252 channels (126 X + 126 Y). Interrogator/transponder frequency offset is +63 MHz for X channels 1-63, -63 MHz for X channels 64-126, +63 MHz for Y channels 1-63, -63 MHz for Y channels 64-126. This is uniform worldwide.
